title: End-to-End Dense Video Grounding via Parallel Regression

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding
task_scope.why_in_or_out: The task explicitly localizes query-relevant temporal moments or highlights.

evidence.quote: # Abstract Video grounding aims to localize the corresponding video moment in an untrimmed video given a language query.

background_setup.summary: # Introduction Video Grounding (VG) is to localize the temporal moment matched with a given language description in an untrimmed video .

evidence.quote: # Introduction Video Grounding (VG) is to localize the temporal moment matched with a given language description in an untrimmed video (Gao et al., 2017; Anne Hendricks et al., 2017; Zhang et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2023).

background_setup.summary: Different from traditional computer vision tasks in video understanding such as action recognition and temporal action localization , which are limited to pre-defined actions, VG allows for an open set of activities with language as queries.

evidence.quote: Different from traditional computer vision tasks in video understanding such as action recognition (Tran et al., 2015; Wang et al., 2016) and temporal action localization (Lin et al., 2018; Tan et al., 2021), which are limited to pre-defined actions, VG allows for an open set of activities with language as queries.
